payload.title: Specify incremental refresh (06_refresh.feature red; fixture open counter)
payload.description:
Specs first, red before green.

**Files:** `features/02_querying/06_refresh.feature` (new, @wip); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`; `src/adapters/fixture.rs` (add `open_count()` — the one deliberate src/adapters touch in this initiative: test-infra observability in the SkipCounter spirit, documented as such); `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (embed).

**Specs:** a second pass after a new fixture session appears ingests only the new one (report: 1 new, rest unchanged); a changed summary (message appended → message_count/last_activity moved) is re-ingested and queries return the new content; a session gone from the source is pruned; refresh is idempotent; unchanged sessions are not re-opened from their adapters (open_count proves it).

**Acceptance:** executable red; @wip kept.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
